note: Migne misprints a scripture reference. Policy (Wilson, 2026-07-18): the TEXT keeps what Migne prints (sacred-marker rule) and refDisplay stays verbatim, but refKey resolves to the CORRECT reference — the index must not propagate bad numbers. The key derived from Migne's printed form is retained as refKeyPrinted so every correction is auditable and reversible.
standard: OSIS book codes; chapter/verse follow the CITED (Vulgate) numbering, per scripts/index-work.mjs. Corrections here fix printer's errors ONLY — they never silently convert Vulgate versification to modern versification, which is a systematic divergence, not an error.

corrections.quote: Exiet Virga de radice Jesse, et flos de radice ejus ascendet
corrections.note: Migne prints II for XI.

corrections.quote: Jugum enim meum suave est, et onus meum leve
corrections.note: Chapter correct, verse wrong: 20 for 30.

corrections.quote: Hostiae impiorum abominabiles
corrections.note: Migne prints II, 2 for XXI, 27.

corrections.quote: melior est finis orationis quam principium
corrections.note: Migne prints XVII for VII. The same verse is cited correctly as 'Eccles. VII, 9' at 1126c in this same work — internal evidence for the correction.

corrections.quote: omnes velit salvos fieri et ad agnitionem veritatis venire
corrections.note: Not Romans at all — the quotation is 1 Tim. 2:4.

corrections.quote: Bonum est nubere, melius est non nubere
corrections.note: The bene/melius comparison is v. 38, not v. 37. The wording is a compressed recast rather than the Vulgate text, but the verse is unambiguous.

corrections.quote: Orationibus instate, vigilantes in illis
corrections.note: Col. 4:2, not Matthew. Appears to be half of a transposition with the note following it.

corrections.quote: Quaerite, et invenietis; pulsate, et aperietur vobis
corrections.note: Matt. 7:7. Book right, chapter and verse displaced — the other half of the 73a transposition.

corrections.quote: Parati semper estote ad rationem reddendam
corrections.note: Verse 15, not 16.

corrections.quote: Verbum Christi habitet in vobis abundanter in omni sapientia
corrections.note: Colossians has only four chapters, so chapter V cannot exist. The quotation is Col. 3:16.

corrections.quote: Nolite thesaurizare vobis thesauros in terra ... Thesaurizate autem vobis thesauros in coelo
corrections.note: Matt. 6:19-20. The printed XIX, 20 looks like the chapter and verse have been transposed.

corrections.quote: Quicunque plus me fecerit domum, aut uxorem, aut filios, non est me dignus
corrections.note: Chapter right, verse wrong: 27 for 37. NB the quotation itself is corrupt (fecerit for a verb of loving; house and wife for father and mother) — the ENGLISH renders the corrupt line as printed and must NOT be conformed to Matt. 10:37.

corrections.quote: Ecce nunc dies salutis
corrections.note: There is no Third Corinthians. The lemma is 2 Cor. 6:2; the chapter numeral is right and only the book ordinal is misprinted, so the key stays chapter-level as Migne cites it.

corrections.quote: Si dixerimus quia peccatum non habemus, nos ipsos seducimus
corrections.note: Migne prints I, 3 for I, 8.

corrections.quote: quatuor animalium in Ezechiele
corrections.note: Migne prints Ezeeh. for Ezech. (broken c). The host sentence names Ezekiel outright and the four living creatures are Ezek. 1, so the reference is not in doubt.

corrections.quote: Nescitis, quia templum Dei estis, et Spiritus sanctus habitat in vobis?
corrections.note: Migne prints the book without its numeral, so the reference does not parse at all. The quoted Latin is 1 Cor. 3:16 verbatim; II Cor. has no such verse.

corrections.quote: ad currendam viam, a summo coelo egressio ejus
corrections.note: A space split the Roman numeral: XV II for XVIII. The quoted words are Ps. 18:6-7 (Vulg.) — 'exsultavit ut gigas ad currendam viam; a summo caelo egressio eius' — so the reference is certain from the quotation itself, and no numeral is being reinterpreted, only rejoined. Printed form kept verbatim in the text and in refDisplay; the indexer could not parse the split numeral at all, so this is the difference between the citation reaching the scripture index and vanishing from it.

corrections.quote: Ipse super maria fundavit eam, et super flumina praeparavit illam
corrections.note: This is an INLINE (running-text) citation, column keyed on the OPENING paren per the 2026-07-31 inline-citation SPEC (the anchor 1121C falls inside it: '(Psal. [1121C] II)'). Migne prints II for the correct chapter; the quoted Latin — 'He founded it upon the seas, and prepared it upon the floods' — is Ps. 23:2 in the CITED Vulgate numbering (Ps. 24:2 modern), which has nothing in common with Ps. 2. Worked example 4 in data/inline-citations/SPEC.md.

corrections.quote: Gratia Dei sum id quod sum
corrections.note: Migne prints the book ordinal-less, so no book name resolves and the note reached unparsed[]. The disambiguation is DETERMINATE, not a judgement: 2 Corinthians has 13 chapters, so a chapter XV can only be 1 Corinthians, and the printed words are 1 Cor. 15:10 verbatim. refDisplay keeps what Migne printed.

corrections.quote: Porro quia vidisti et pedum, et digitorum partem testeam figuli, et partem ferream, regnum divisum erit
corrections.note: Chapter numeral wrong: I for II. The printed words are Dan. 2:41 verbatim, the work's own running lemma, and Migne prints (Dan. II) over the same lemma elsewhere in this work. No source-attribution reading is available: Daniel is the book cited and the book quoted.

corrections.quote: esse sub sentibus delicias computat
corrections.note: Chapter numeral wrong: XXII for XXX. Richard's own frame reads secundum sententiam Job, so the book is right and only the chapter is wrong; the words are Job 30:7.

corrections.quote: Ne magnitudo revelationum extollat me, datus est mihi stimulus carnis meae angelus Satanae, qui me colaphizet
corrections.note: Book ordinal wrong: I for II. The words are 2 Cor. 12:7 verbatim and the frame is cum Apostolus ipse de seipso dicat. 1 Corinthians 12 is the body-and-members chapter and contains nothing of this.

corrections.quote: Ascendens super equos tuos, et equitatus tuus sanitas
corrections.note: Migne prints Rabac. for Habac., an R for an H. Confirmed on the plate as his own, not our digitization's. The words are Habacuc 3:8, which he also quotes divergently.

corrections.quote: adhaerere Deo
corrections.note: Migne prints CXVIII, 72 for LXXII, 28. Confirmed at the plate. Identified from the words, not the numeral: Psalm 118 does have a verse 72, and it is not these words.

corrections.quote: videbimus eum sicut est
corrections.note: The book ordinal is dropped, not mistyped: Joan. for I Joan. Confirmed at the plate. The words are 1 John 3:2; the Gospel's chapter 3 has nothing of them.

corrections.quote: Aedificavit atrium interius tribus ordinibus
corrections.note: A wrong book, not a wrong numeral, and not even a wrong Testament: the words are III Reg. 6:36, the verse this gloss is expounding, cited as I Cor. II. Confirmed at the plate; he cites I Cor. correctly twice on the facing page.

corrections.quote: Ego plantavi, Apollo rigavit, Dominus autem incrementum dedit
corrections.note: Book ordinal wrong: II for I. Confirmed at the plate. The words are 1 Cor. 3:6 verbatim.

corrections.quote: stella a stella differat in claritate
corrections.note: Book ordinal wrong: II for I. Confirmed at the plate. The words are 1 Cor. 15:41; 2 Corinthians has no chapter 15.

corrections.quote: In domo Patris mei mansiones multae sunt
corrections.note: Chapter wrong: XV for XIV. Confirmed at the plate. The words are John 14:2 verbatim.

corrections.quote: Haec in proverbiis locutus sum vobis
corrections.note: Migne prints VI for XVI. The words are John 16:25 verbatim.

corrections.quote: Ego ex ore Altissimi prodii, primogenita ante omnem creaturam
corrections.note: Not a wrong chapter but a wrong book: Ecclesiasticus 24:5 cited as Isaias.

corrections.quote: Venite, benedicti
corrections.note: Migne prints XV for XXV. The note sits on Venite, benedicti (Matt. 25:34); the clause opening the run, Qui benedixit nos in omni benedictione spirituali, is Eph. 1:3.

corrections.quote: Si peccaverit in te frater tuus, increpa illum
corrections.note: The words are Luke 17:3; Matt. 18:15 reads vade et corripe eum. Paired with the note at 1088A, where Luke is printed for Matthew: the two evangelists have been exchanged.

corrections.quote: Sed eum timete qui potest animam et corpus perdere in gehennam
corrections.note: The words are Matt. 10:28; Luke 12:5 reads qui habet potestatem mittere in gehennam. Paired with the note at 1085D, where Matthew is printed for Luke.

corrections.quote: Qui enim non honorificat Filium, non honorificat Patrem, qui misit illum
corrections.note: The words are John 5:23 verbatim. John 3 has qui non credit Filio, neither these words nor this argument.

corrections.quote: Humiliamini sub potenti manu Dei, ut exaltet vos in tempore visitationis
corrections.note: The words are 1 Peter 5:6 verbatim; 1 Peter 3 has no such clause.

corrections.quote: Pauperis in judicio non misereberis
corrections.note: A transposed numeral, XIII for XXIII. Exodus 13 is the consecration of the firstborn.

corrections.quote: Et Dominus quidem Jesus postquam locutus est eis, assumptus est in coelum
corrections.note: The words are Mark 16:19 verbatim, and Migne's own sentence introduces them Aliter Marcus commemorat dicens.

corrections.quote: In sanguine testamenti eduxisti vinctos tuos de lacu, in quo non est aqua
corrections.note: Migne prints V for IX. The words are Zach. 9:11.

corrections.quote: Beati qui persecutionem patiuntur propter Deum
corrections.note: The words are the eighth beatitude, Matt. 5:10. Matthew VI contains no beatitude.

corrections.quote: Firmum fundamentum Domini stat
corrections.note: Verse wrong: 9 for 19. 2 Tim. 2:9 reads usque ad vincula quasi male operans.

corrections.quote: Omne morticinum et captum a bestia de avibus et pecoribus, sacerdotes non comedant
corrections.note: The clinching words sacerdotes non comedant stand only at Ezech. 44:31. Ezechiel 4:14 has morticinum non comedi, of the prophet himself, with no priests and no prohibition.

corrections.quote: Omnis qui se regem facit, contradicit Caesari
corrections.note: Migne prints XVIII for XIX. The words stand in the trial before Pilate, one chapter later.

corrections.quote: Ex ipso, et per ipsum, et in ipso sunt omnia
corrections.note: The words are Rom. 11:36 verbatim. Romans II is the judgment of the Gentiles.
